beforePause.dialog:
OPERATOR HANDBOOK
×
SWIPE INSTRUCTIONS ↑
MOVE WITH PURPOSE.
MOVE gently for small steps. Hold FIRE: small drags aim precisely, longer drags turn farther. AIM slows corrections further. Swipe the scene to turn. TOOLS holds SWAP, CROUCH and RUN. Hold MOVE forward against low cover to vault.
MAP pauses to plan. Near a receiver, hold USE and steer into its ring. Your suit brakes to recover, even with MOVE held. Release USE to move freely.
After three memories, destroy the numbered copper coils. Amber means cover; cyan means an exposed firing window. Move to a clear face.
When the jammer falls, return to the marked uplink deck and survive the upload. DASH helps reposition; JUMP becomes VAULT near low cover.
FULL TACTICAL HANDBOOK
UNDERSTOOD
↗
